parameters.content:
## Verified n8n backups in a Notion catalog

### How it works
For n8n operators who need a readable catalog and recoverable workflow exports. Run manually or hourly. The companion creates or reuses a Notion catalog with 14 typed properties. The main workflow discovers visible sources, updates stable documentation pages and attaches complete JSON exports.

Downloaded bytes and SHA-256 are checked before replacing a managed attachment. Unchanged sources reuse their verified copy; personal notes remain. Failed or oversized uploads retain the previous backup. This is a one-way definition backup, not a complete instance backup.

### Setup
1. Import [the companion setup workflow](https://github.com/paoloronco/n8n-templates/blob/main/workflows/n8n-notion-workflow-backup/setup-notion-catalog.json). Bind its Notion credential and save it inactive.
2. Bind n8n read-only and Notion credentials in the main HTTP nodes. Share one parent page with the Notion integration, including file-upload access.
3. In **Configuration**, set setupWorkflowId, notionParentPageId, instance URLs and a stable catalogTitle. Leave documentationDataSourceId empty for automatic creation. Run initial setup sequentially.
4. Run manually; inspect documentation and download/import a JSON into a separate inactive workflow. Repeat to check reuse before enabling the schedule.

### Customization
Adjust source filters, timezone, pacing and file limits. Enable optional email only after configuring SMTP and addresses. Recognizable secrets are redacted heuristically; review confidential parameters. Credential secrets, encryption keys and the n8n database need separate backups.

[Detailed configuration and restore guide](https://github.com/paoloronco/n8n-templates/blob/main/workflows/n8n-notion-workflow-backup/README.md)

## 01 · Start and configure

Manual and hourly runs share one configuration. Set the destination, instance URLs and source filters here. API permissions define coverage; active, inactive and archived workflows are included by default.

## 03 · Dispatch one API request

Preserve the current state, pace requests, then route to read-only n8n, Notion JSON or file upload. Service responses rejoin before verification. The return loop advances one bounded request at a time.

## 04 · Verify before advancing

Join each response with its saved state. Download attached JSON when required; verify bytes, identity and SHA-256 before promoting a replacement. Personal notes and the previous verified copy survive failed verification.

## 06 · Report and finish

Compare expected coverage with actual results. Email is optional and checks SMTP acceptance. Both notified and skipped results reach the final outcome; an incomplete backup cannot finish as a successful sync.

## 05 · Collect execution failures

Errors from setup, requests and verification enter the shared failure report. Partial coverage stays a failure; the final outcome exposes it after optional notification. Use an independent Error Workflow for unexpected failures.

## 02 · Create or reuse the catalog

The companion provisions the page, database and 14 columns before discovery. Existing compatible catalogs are reused. Conflicting types stop setup. Save the companion and select its ID in Configuration.
